title: ConnectorOAuth
description:
OAuth public-client metadata (no client_secret; ADR-060, docs/07 §6).

The desktop client runs the authorization-code + PKCE flow itself: it opens the system browser at [`authorize_url`](Self::authorize_url), listens on an ephemeral loopback redirect (RFC 8252), then exchanges the code at [`token_url`](Self::token_url). Tokens stay in the client keychain; the server only stores this non-secret metadata.
